bvw_fastmnn_monocle_umap_plots

Sarah Hazell Pickering

2025-03-12

Setup

library(BPCells)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(monocle3)
library(viridis)
module = "beige_vs_white"
method_name = "fastmnn"
dataname = paste0("tss_",method_name)
load_data = T #loading data
subset_data = F

rmd_filename = "tss_fastmnn_monocle_umap_plots"
i_am(file.path("analysis", module, paste0(rmd_filename,".Rmd")))
## here() starts at /projects/imb-pkbphil/sp/sc_rnaseq/progenitor_scrnaseq
odir = here("output", module, dataname)
set.seed(8)
fig_dir = here("analysis", module, "figures", rmd_filename)
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = paste0(fig_dir, "/"),
                      dev = c("png","pdf"))

if (!dir.exists(odir)) dir.create(odir, recursive = TRUE)
theme_hp = theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        strip.background = element_blank())
theme_set(theme_hp)
pal_white = c("#B3B3B3","#85C2EA","#1F78B4")
pal_beige = c("#B3B3B3", "#F18486","#E31A1C")
pal = c("#1F78B4","#85C2EA","#B3B3B3", "#F18486","#E31A1C")
prog_cols = c("#DA1819","#691A93","#EBB400" , "#434D51","#00AED1","#3AAD00","#FF7F00")
prog_levels = c("p5","p4","p6","p3","p0","p1","p2")
names(prog_cols) = paste0("p", 0:(length(prog_levels)-1))
clusters = tvthemes::gravityFalls_pal()(13)
names(clusters) = 0:11
spectral = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = 'Spectral'))
beige =  readRDS(here(odir,"beige_monocle_complete_analysis_umap.rds"))
white = readRDS(here(odir,"white_monocle_complete_analysis_umap.rds"))
beige

colnames(colData(beige))

Beige Trajectory

table(beige$time.progen_clusters)
## 
##    p0    p1    p2    p3    p4    p5    p6    p7  day0  day1  day3 
##  2888  2400   637   653   364   167   103     0    97  2459 10848
table(beige$progen_clusters,useNA="ifany")
## 
##     0     1     2     3     4     5     6  <NA> 
##  2888  2400   637   653   364   167   103 13404
beige$only_progen_clusters = beige$progen_clusters
beige$progen_clusters = beige$time.progen_clusters
p=plot_cells(beige, color_cells_by = "progen_clusters", label_leaves = F, label_branch_points = F, 
                trajectory_graph_color="black", label_cell_groups = F,  cell_size=0.5)+
  scale_colour_manual(values=c(prog_cols, pal_beige))
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour = 'transparent' 
p 

p=plot_cells(beige, color_cells_by = "progen_clusters", label_leaves = F, label_branch_points = F, 
                trajectory_graph_color="black", label_cell_groups = F,  cell_size=0.2)+
  scale_colour_manual(values=c(prog_cols, pal_beige))
p$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour = 'transparent'
p + facet_wrap(~ time.progen_clusters)

white trajectory

white$only_progen_clusters = white$progen_clusters
white$progen_clusters = white$time.progen_clusters
w=plot_cells(white, color_cells_by = "progen_clusters", label_leaves = F, label_branch_points = F, 
                trajectory_graph_color="black", label_cell_groups = F,  cell_size=0.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c(prog_cols, pal_white),name = "cluster")
w$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour = 'transparent'
w

w=plot_cells(white, color_cells_by = "progen_clusters", label_leaves = F, label_branch_points = F, 
                trajectory_graph_color="black", label_cell_groups = F, cell_size=0.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c(prog_cols, pal_white),name = "cluster")
w$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour = 'transparent'
w + facet_wrap(~ progen_clusters)

white_progen = white[,subset(colData(white), grepl("^p[0-7]",time.progen_clusters)) %>%row.names]
w=plot_cells(white_progen, color_cells_by = "progen_clusters", label_leaves = F, label_branch_points = F, 
                trajectory_graph_color="black", label_cell_groups = F, cell_size=0.2)
w$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour = 'transparent'
w + facet_wrap(~ progen_clusters) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c(prog_cols, pal_white),name = "cluster")

Violin plot of pseudotime

if (subset_data){
  sbs = readRDS(here(odir, "10%_complete_analysis.rds"))
  Idents(sbs) = "seurat_clusters"
} else {
  sbs = readRDS(here(odir, "complete_analysis.rds"))
  DefaultAssay(sbs) = "RNA"
}
sbs
## An object of class Seurat 
## 77117 features across 33923 samples within 2 assays 
## Active assay: RNA (75117 features, 2000 variable features)
##  3 layers present: data, counts, scale.data
##  1 other assay present: mnn.reconstructed
##  8 dimensional reductions calculated: pca, umap, tsne, initial.umap, initial.tsne, pca.fastmnn, umap.fastmnn, tsne.fastmnn
Idents(sbs) = "sample"
sbs_white = subset(sbs, idents=c("asc_day0", "white_day1","white_day3"))
summary(colnames(white) == rownames(sbs_white@meta.data))
##    Mode    TRUE 
## logical   20616
sbs_white$raw_pseudotime = pseudotime(white)
sbs_white$monocle_pseudotime =   scales::rescale(pseudotime(white), to = c(1, 0)) #rescale from 1 to 0 (cos were tracing backwards from  day3)
sbs_white$pscondition ="white"

sbs_beige = subset(sbs, idents=c("asc_day0", "beige_day1","beige_day3"))
summary(colnames(beige) == rownames(sbs_beige@meta.data))
##    Mode    TRUE 
## logical   20616
sbs_beige$raw_pseudotime = pseudotime(beige)
sbs_beige$monocle_pseudotime =   scales::rescale(sbs_beige$raw_pseudotime, to = c(1, 0)) #rescale from 1 to 0 (cos were tracing backwards from  day3)
sbs_beige$pscondition ="beige"
merged_obj <- merge(x = sbs_white, y = sbs_beige, add.cell.ids = c("white","beige"), merge.dr = F)
merged_obj
## An object of class Seurat 
## 77117 features across 41232 samples within 2 assays 
## Active assay: RNA (75117 features, 2000 variable features)
##  6 layers present: data.1, data.2, counts.1, scale.data.1, counts.2, scale.data.2
##  1 other assay present: mnn.reconstructed
merged_obj$progen_clusters = factor(merged_obj$progen_clusters, levels=c(paste0("p",0:7),paste0("day",c(0,1,3))))
head(merged_obj@meta.data)

## Scale for y is already present.

meta_white = sbs_white@meta.data %>% mutate(pscondition = "white")
meta_beige = sbs_beige@meta.data %>% mutate(pscondition = "beige")
meta = rbind(meta_white, meta_beige)
meta  = mutate(meta, sample_or_progen_cluster = 
                    if_else(time.progen_clusters %in% c("day1","day3"), 
                            meta$cond.time,  
                            time.progen_clusters))
meta$sample_or_progen_cluster = factor(meta$sample_or_progen_cluster, 
                                       levels=c(prog_levels, c("day0","white.day1", "beige.day1","white.day3","beige.day3")))
str(meta)

horizontal pseudotime

ps_cols = c(prog_cols, pal_white[2:3])
names(ps_cols) = c(names(prog_cols), "day1","day3")
ggplot(filter(meta, sample_or_progen_cluster != "day0"), 
       aes(x=monocle_pseudotime, y=time.progen_clusters, fill=time.progen_clusters)) + 
    geom_violin(scale="width")+
  facet_grid(pscondition~.) + scale_fill_manual(values=ps_cols, name="identity") + 
  scale_y_discrete(limits=c(paste0("day",c(3,1)), rev(prog_levels)))

ggplot(filter(meta, sample_or_progen_cluster != "day0"), 
       aes(x=monocle_pseudotime, y=time.progen_clusters, fill=sample_or_progen_cluster)) + 
    geom_violin(scale="width")+
  facet_grid(pscondition~.) + scale_fill_manual(values=c(prog_cols, pal[c(2,4,1,5)]), name="identity") + 
  scale_y_discrete(limits=c(paste0("day",c(3,1)), rev(prog_levels)))

Save

if (subset_data == FALSE){
  write.table(meta, here(odir,"monocle_pseudotime.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names = F, quote=F)
} else if (subset_data){ #if subset, don't save complete analysis
  write.table(meta, file =here(odir,"10%_monocle_pseudotime.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names = F, quote=F)
}
